title: 2026 Great Britain F-gas quota and CO2e QA controls

sources.publisher: Environment Agency and Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: Applying for quota to produce or import F gas

sources.publisher: Environment Agency and Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: Fluorinated gas guidance for users producers and traders

facts.source_fact: Quota is required to produce or import bulk HFCs for placing on the market in Great Britain.
facts.expected_handling: Apply Great Britain and bulk-HFC scope before quota checks.

facts.source_fact: Hydrofluorocarbons are the most common type of fluorinated gas covered by the quota system.
facts.expected_handling: Do not generalise the quota rule to every fluorinated gas without checking scope.

facts.source_fact: F-gas quota is calculated in equivalent tonnes of carbon dioxide.
facts.expected_handling: Store quota values with CO2e units.

facts.source_fact: Quota represents the quantity of HFCs allocated for placing on the Great Britain market.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat quota as actual emitted mass.

facts.source_fact: The quota requirement applies to relevant production or import of bulk HFCs.
facts.expected_handling: Separate production, import and downstream-use records.

facts.source_fact: The guidance distinguishes incumbent quota holders.
facts.expected_handling: Record incumbent status and applicable allocation route.

facts.source_fact: Businesses needing bulk HFC quota can apply through the F-gas service subject to the applicable rules.
facts.expected_handling: Require application provenance for newly allocated quota.

facts.source_fact: F-gas quota holders can transfer quota to another business under the guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Track transferor, transferee and amount separately.

facts.source_fact: Quota holders can authorise quota for another business where the rules allow.
facts.expected_handling: Distinguish authorisation from ownership transfer.

facts.source_fact: Quota can be delegated under the Great Britain F-gas system where applicable.
facts.expected_handling: Track delegation separately from transfer and authorisation.

facts.source_fact: An organisation based outside Great Britain and Northern Ireland needs an eligible representative to obtain Great Britain quota.
facts.expected_handling: Require representative provenance for non-GB/NI organisations.

facts.source_fact: The representative must be a company based in Great Britain or Northern Ireland and responsible for regulatory compliance.
facts.expected_handling: Validate representative location and responsibility.

facts.source_fact: EU market quota is separate from Great Britain F-gas quota.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix GB and EU quota records.

facts.source_fact: The UK HFC phase-down targets a 79 percent reduction by 2030 relative to average 2009 to 2012 use.
facts.expected_handling: Treat the phase-down percentage as a policy baseline, not a site emission result.

facts.source_fact: Global warming potential values are used to calculate carbon-dioxide equivalent for F gases.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the GWP version into CO2e calculations.

facts.source_fact: Reporting templates can require GWP values at greater precision than rounded public guidance tables.
facts.expected_handling: Use the reporting-template precision when preparing regulated reports.

facts.source_fact: An allocated HFC quota is a market-placement allowance and is not evidence that the gas was emitted.
facts.expected_handling: Prevent quota-to-emission inference.

facts.source_fact: Equipment pre-charged with F gas is subject to specific quota and reporting rules separate from bulk-gas allocation.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the appropriate product or bulk-gas route.

facts.source_fact: The quota guidance was updated on 3 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the 2026 guidance version to current checks.

facts.source_fact: F-gas quota is organisation and market governance, not parcel-level measured emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Prevent parcel-level inference.

guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents quota being misreported as emissions.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach gas type, GB market, organisation and transaction type.
Attach allocation period and guidance version.
Carry GWP, service and transaction provenance.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents untraceable CO2e or quota values.

guard_patterns.handling: Do not convert quota into parcel-level emissions.
